shared_elements: incised linear outline designs on an upright slab
curved arc / arched line spanning the upper area
centrally organised composition following the slab's contour
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing a single schematic, outline-incised composition centred on the face and topped by a broad arc, with angular chevron forms and a band of repeated wavy/scalloped line lower down. But the subjects differ fundamentally: A depicts an anthropomorphic figure with facial features, arms, concentric-circle ornaments and a belt-like band, while B depicts what reads as a masted vessel with a hull over water inside a framing arch, with no human or body imagery at all.
